answer: A hostile operator as a result has to keep each alias continuously active for 46 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. The umber counter is kept in copper and trellis shows each reset. A bond is refunded only after 46 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The per-identity price is 60 dollars, and it is forfeited outright on the first bad verdict. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
